About The Shop

D&V Barber Shop is Richmond's no-fuss, old-school barbershop. No appointments, no waiting games — walk in, take a seat, and get a clean cut from barbers who take pride in every chair. That's how we've earned a perfect 5.0 rating on Google.

Our Services

Classic Haircuts

Precision cuts, styled the way you like them — every chair, every time.

Skin Fades

Clean, sharp fades finished with a straight-razor detail around the edges.

Beard Trims

Shape, line-up and a tidy finish for a beard that means business.

Straight-Razor Detail

Crisp edges and a clean neckline — the finishing touch that makes the cut.

Kids' Cuts

Patient, friendly cuts for young gentlemen — first haircut or fiftieth.

Walk-In Service

Our signature service: just walk in. First come, first served — simple as that.

Good To Know

Do I need an appointment?

No — D&V is walk-ins only. Service is first come, first served, so just drop in during opening hours.

When are you open?

Tuesday to Friday 9 AM–6 PM and Saturday 9 AM–2 PM. We're closed on Sundays and Mondays.

Where is the shop?

You'll find us at 527 Leighway Dr in Richmond, Kentucky. Tap "Get Directions" at the top of this page and your maps app will bring you right to the door.

Why the perfect rating?

Our customers rate us 5.0 on Google across 56 reviews — sharp cuts, fair turns, and a proper old-school barbershop welcome.

Just walk in — we'll take care of the rest. 💈
